{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# =============================================================================
# Alpha Ablation v2: RASP scoring S(h) = I(h) × (1-F(h))^α
# α ∈ {0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0}, sparsity=20%, GSM8K N=100 fast eval
#
# Disk-safe: sequential prune → eval → delete per α value.
# α=1.0 reuses existing pruned model (no prune, no delete).
#
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/run_alpha_ablation_v2.sh            # run all
#   bash scripts/run_alpha_ablation_v2.sh --dry-run   # validate setup only
# =============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune

# --- Config ---
MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B"
IMPORTANCE="results/importance_scores.pt"
CKA="results/cka_scores.pt"
DATA_ROOT="/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune"
EVAL_DIR="${DATA_ROOT}/eval_results/alpha_ablation"
LOG_DIR="${DATA_ROOT}/logs"
SPARSITY=0.20
EVAL_SAMPLES=100
EXISTING_ALPHA10="/root/autodl-tmp/pruned_rasp_20"

ALPHAS=(0.0 0.25 0.5 0.75 1.0)

DRY_RUN=false
if [[ "${1:-}" == "--dry-run" ]]; then
    DRY_RUN=true
fi

mkdir -p "$EVAL_DIR" "$LOG_DIR"

# --- Auto GPU selection: pick the GPU with most free memory ---
select_gpu() {
    local gpu
    gpu=$(python3 -c "
import torch
if not torch.cuda.is_available():
    print(0); exit()
free = []
for i in range(min(torch.cuda.device_count(), 2)):
    free.append((torch.cuda.mem_get_info(i)[0], i))
print(sorted(free, reverse=True)[0][1])
" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    echo "$gpu"
}

GPU=$(select_gpu)
echo "=========================================="
echo "Alpha Ablation v2 (RASP scoring)"
echo "  Alphas: ${ALPHAS[*]}"
echo "  Sparsity: ${SPARSITY}"
echo "  Eval samples: ${EVAL_SAMPLES}"
echo "  GPU: cuda:${GPU}"
echo "  Start: $(date)"
echo "=========================================="

# --- Dry-run checks ---
if $DRY_RUN; then
    echo ""
    echo "[DRY-RUN] Validating setup..."
    errors=0

    # Check base model
    if [ -d "$MODEL" ]; then
        echo "  [OK] Base model: $MODEL"
    else
        echo "  [FAIL] Base model not found: $MODEL"; ((errors++))
    fi

    # Check score files
    for f in "$IMPORTANCE" "$CKA"; do
        if [ -f "$f" ]; then
            echo "  [OK] Score file: $f ($(du -h "$f" | cut -f1))"
        else
            echo "  [FAIL] Score file not found: $f"; ((errors++))
        fi
    done

    # Check α=1.0 model
    if [ -d "$EXISTING_ALPHA10" ]; then
        echo "  [OK] α=1.0 model: $EXISTING_ALPHA10"
    else
        echo "  [FAIL] α=1.0 model not found: $EXISTING_ALPHA10"; ((errors++))
    fi

    # Check prune.py --alpha
    python src/prune.py --help 2>&1 | grep -q "\-\-alpha" && \
        echo "  [OK] prune.py supports --alpha" || \
        { echo "  [FAIL] prune.py missing --alpha flag"; ((errors++)); }

    # Check eval_gsm8k.py --max_samples
    python src/eval_gsm8k.py --help 2>&1 | grep -q "\-\-max_samples" && \
        echo "  [OK] eval_gsm8k.py supports --max_samples" || \
        { echo "  [FAIL] eval_gsm8k.py missing --max_samples flag"; ((errors++)); }

    # Check disk
    avail_gb=$(df --output=avail /root/autodl-tmp | tail -1)
    avail_gb=$((avail_gb / 1024 / 1024))
    if [ "$avail_gb" -ge 15 ]; then
        echo "  [OK] Disk: ${avail_gb}GB free (need ~12GB per prune cycle)"
    else
        echo "  [WARN] Disk: only ${avail_gb}GB free"; ((errors++))
    fi

    # Check existing results
    echo ""
    echo "  Existing results:"
    for alpha in "${ALPHAS[@]}"; do
        tag=$(echo "$alpha" | tr '.' '_')
        result="${EVAL_DIR}/eval_alpha_${tag}.json"
        if [ -f "$result" ]; then
            echo "    α=${alpha}: DONE ($(du -h "$result" | cut -f1))"
        else
            echo "    α=${alpha}: pending"
        fi
    done

    echo ""
    if [ $errors -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "[DRY-RUN] All checks passed. Ready to run."
    else
        echo "[DRY-RUN] ${errors} issue(s) found."
    fi
    exit 0
fi

# --- Main loop: sequential prune → eval → cleanup ---
for alpha in "${ALPHAS[@]}"; do
    tag=$(echo "$alpha" | tr '.' '_')
    eval_output="${EVAL_DIR}/eval_alpha_${tag}.json"
